jobs.title: Design codex
jobs.objective: Design RFC 0039 Phase 2 (Steps 3-6) across two tracks. Track A (CLI integration + mutating verbs, codex Go): wire `striatum daemon start --core go` in src/striatum/cli/daemon.py (and parser plumbing in src/striatum/cli/parser.py) so the Python CLI launches the Go binary via subprocess + env (STRIATUM_DAEMON_CORE, STRIATUMD_GO_BIN); read-side and write-side RPC dispatch in `go/pkg/rpc/registry.go` extended to cover claim-next/ack/heartbeat/complete/block/release, artifact.publish, review.submit/verdict, decision.record, checkpoint.resolve, recovery.requeue_stale/cancel_job/resume, worktree.create, branch.confirm, run.prepare/start/pause/resume/cancel, workflow.validate/generate; apply service in `go/pkg/apply/{receipt.go,service.go}` mirroring src/striatum/daemon_apply/; MCP capability gating in `go/pkg/mcp/{capabilities.go,tools.go}` mirroring src/striatum/daemon_rpc/mcp.py; cross-repo lifecycle in `go/pkg/crossrepo/{prepare.go,lifecycle.go}`. Track B (supervisor + distribution + CI, claude Go + Python harness): supervised process lifecycle in `go/pkg/supervisor/{pointer.go,liveness.go,pty.go}` using os/exec + creack/pty mirroring src/striatum/daemon.py supervisor + src/striatum/daemon_supervisor/; packet delivery via FIFO matching the Python wrapper protocol; heartbeat from supervised-progress signal per the V1.6 follow-up; deterministic SIGTERM cleanup with waitgroup drain; lost-detection via pidfile + supervisor pointer in Postgres; distribution — cross-compile linux-amd64/linux-arm64/darwin-amd64/darwin-arm64 in CI; package-data shim under src/striatum/_daemongo/ that ships the per-platform binary inside the Python wheel (binary-payload pattern like psycopg[binary]); top-level Makefile gains daemon-go-build / daemon-go-install / daemon-go-release targets; CI matrix `daemon_core={python,go}` on Linux + macOS for the full RFC 0035 multi-repo harness + tests/test_daemon_go_*.py. Cite go/cmd/striatumd/main.go, go/pkg/rpc/{registry,server,auth_pg}.go, go/pkg/db/{audit,connection,migrations}.go, src/striatum/daemon.py, src/striatum/daemon_apply/, src/striatum/daemon_rpc/{registry,mcp,multi_repo}.py, src/striatum/daemon_supervisor/, src/striatum/cli/{daemon,parser,dispatch,mutations}.py, tests/_harness/daemon.py, tests/conftest.py, Makefile, .github/workflows/. D094 (Postgres-sole-substrate, daemon-required) framing: Go daemon implements RFC 0030 over the same Postgres schema as Python daemon — no parallel SQLite path. `daemon_core` parameter defaults to `python` until Step 6 flips default in a follow-up RFC.

jobs.objective: Reconcile the three designs into one concrete plan with two implementer tracks: Track A (CLI integration + mutating verbs in Go, codex) and Track B (supervisor lifecycle in Go + distribution + CI matrix, claude). Pick one path per decision — do not enumerate alternatives. Lock exact Go file paths, RPC method names, capability mapping, FIFO packet schema, CI matrix shape, and wheel package-data layout.

jobs.title: Review design claude ergonomics_dx
jobs.objective: Review the synthesis. Are Steps 3+4 (CLI integration + mutating verbs) and Steps 5+6 (supervisor + distribution + CI) cleanly separated with explicit non-overlapping Go file paths? Is the `--core go` flag wiring named with exact line in src/striatum/cli/parser.py and exact dispatch hook in src/striatum/cli/daemon.py? Are all mutating RPC methods enumerated against src/striatum/cli/mutations.py and src/striatum/daemon_rpc/registry.py? Is the supervisor FIFO packet schema byte-compatible with the Python wrapper protocol? Is the CI matrix shape concrete (job names, OS list, daemon_core matrix, Postgres ephemeral wiring)? Is the wheel package-data approach for the Go binary safe (per-platform tag, fallback to STRIATUMD_GO_BIN, no embedded binary in sdist)? Backward-compat: daemon_core defaults to python until Step 6 flips default in a follow-up — confirm no implicit flip lands here.

jobs.title: Implement Track A CLI integration + mutating verbs in Go (codex)
jobs.objective: Track A — Steps 3+4 of RFC 0039 Phase 2. (1) CLI integration: wire `striatum daemon start --core go` in src/striatum/cli/daemon.py + src/striatum/cli/parser.py. Honor STRIATUM_DAEMON_CORE env var; resolve binary via STRIATUMD_GO_BIN override or `go/bin/striatumd` default (matching tests/_harness/daemon.py). `daemon_core` defaults to `python` (Step 6 flips default in a follow-up). Python CLI client continues to speak RFC 0030 envelope-v1 over the Unix socket regardless of daemon language. (2) Mutating verbs on the Go core: extend `go/pkg/rpc/registry.go` to register every mutation in src/striatum/cli/mutations.py per RFC 0043 §5 table (session.register, work.claim_next / ack / heartbeat / complete / block / release, artifact.publish, review.submit / verdict, decision.record, checkpoint.resolve, recovery.requeue_stale / cancel_job / resume, worktree.create, branch.confirm, run.prepare / start / pause / resume / cancel, workflow.validate / generate) with the same capability bindings as the Python daemon. (3) Apply service: land `go/pkg/apply/{receipt.go,service.go}` mirroring src/striatum/daemon_apply/ (apply receipt schema + fail-closed authority semantics). (4) MCP capability gating: land `go/pkg/mcp/{capabilities.go,tools.go}` mirroring src/striatum/daemon_rpc/mcp.py — RFC 0032 capability-gated tools/call + tools/list filter + audit row append. (5) Cross-repo lifecycle: land `go/pkg/crossrepo/{prepare.go,lifecycle.go}` mirroring src/striatum/daemon_rpc/multi_repo.py. Sub-agents per cluster: parser/dispatch wiring, registry expansion (claim / write / review / admin / recovery), apply service, MCP tools, cross-repo lifecycle, Go unit tests + integration via tests/_harness/daemon.py with daemon_core=go. Do NOT modify go/pkg/supervisor/, the Makefile distribution targets, CI workflow files, or src/striatum/_daemongo/ — sister Track B owns those. Backward-compat: Python daemon must keep working; `daemon_core` parameter defaults to `python`. D094 framing: Go daemon implements RFC 0030 over the same Postgres schema as the Python daemon — no parallel SQLite path.

jobs.title: Implement Track B supervisor + distribution + CI (claude Go + Python harness)
jobs.objective: Track B — Steps 5+6 of RFC 0039 Phase 2. (1) Supervisor lifecycle in Go: land `go/pkg/supervisor/{pointer.go,liveness.go,pty.go}` mirroring src/striatum/daemon.py supervisor + src/striatum/daemon_supervisor/ with os/exec + creack/pty. Note: go.mod / go.sum belong to Track A's write scope — if creack/pty needs to be added as a runtime dep, hand the exact module line + sha sum off via your HANDOFF and Track A folds it during their registry expansion (a2 if needed). Implement start, attach, heartbeat from supervised-progress signal, packet delivery via FIFO (byte-compatible with the Python wrapper protocol), stop, lost-detection via pidfile + supervisor pointer in Postgres. Deterministic SIGTERM cleanup using a signal channel + waitgroup drain (the well-trodden Go pattern). (2) Distribution: cross-compile linux-amd64 / linux-arm64 / darwin-amd64 / darwin-arm64 binaries; top-level Makefile gains daemon-go-build / daemon-go-install / daemon-go-release targets; go/Makefile produces go/bin/striatumd<-platform>. Land src/striatum/_daemongo/ package-data shim that ships the per-platform Go binary inside the Python wheel (binary-payload pattern like psycopg[binary]); CLI binary resolver checks the shipped wheel binary first, then STRIATUMD_GO_BIN override, then `go/bin/striatumd` for in-tree dev. pyproject.toml package-data + MANIFEST.in updates as needed. (3) CI matrix `daemon_core={python,go}` on Linux + macOS: extend .github/workflows/ with two explicit jobs per OS (CORE=python, CORE=go) running `make test-multi-repo` against ephemeral Postgres. Wire `tests/test_daemon_go_supervisor.py` covering supervised lane start, packet delivery, heartbeat, lost-detection, SIGTERM cleanup. Sub-agents per concern: pty + os/exec supervisor, FIFO packet shim, pidfile + lost-detection, SIGTERM + waitgroup drain, top-level Makefile targets, go/Makefile cross-compile targets, src/striatum/_daemongo/ package-data, pyproject.toml/MANIFEST.in, CI workflow file edits, supervisor test fixture. Reconcile sub-agent outputs yourself before writing HANDOFF. Do NOT touch go/pkg/rpc/, go/pkg/apply/, go/pkg/mcp/, go/pkg/crossrepo/, src/striatum/cli/daemon.py, or src/striatum/cli/parser.py — sister Track A owns those. Backward-compat: Python daemon must keep working; `daemon_core` defaults to `python` until Step 6 flips default in a follow-up RFC.

jobs.title: Build review codex threat_model
jobs.objective: Threat-model review across both tracks: (Track A) every mutation in src/striatum/cli/mutations.py is registered on the Go core with the matching capability binding — no method bypass; apply service fail-closed authority semantics preserved; MCP capability filter denies unauthorized tools/list entries; cross-repo lifecycle audit-row append fires per RFC 0032; --core go subprocess launch closes file descriptors / sockets correctly; daemon_core defaults to python (no implicit flip). (Track B) supervisor SIGTERM cleanup deterministic (no orphan PTY); FIFO packet schema byte-compatible with Python wrapper protocol; lost-detection sound under PID recycling; package-data binary tagged per-platform (no Linux binary shipping into a macOS wheel); CI matrix actually runs both CORE=python and CORE=go (no all-skipped silent pass per dogfood-047 F3 finding). D094 framing intact across both tracks.

jobs.title: Build review claude ergonomics_dx
jobs.objective: Operator UX review: `striatum daemon start --core go` legible error when binary is missing (names STRIATUMD_GO_BIN + `make daemon-go-build` remediation); `--core go` works alongside `--foreground` and `--socket`; wheel install ships the Go binary transparently or names the install step; CI failure surfaces clearly (matrix axis identifies CORE=python vs CORE=go in job names); supervisor heartbeat + lost-detection visible in `striatum dashboard`; Makefile targets discoverable via `make help` if present. Documentation deltas are operator-only — implementers do not touch README/TODO/CHANGELOG/SPEC/HOW_TO.

jobs.title: Build review gemini adversarial
jobs.objective: Adversarial: --core flag escape paths (env var, alias, config file); a mutation in src/striatum/cli/mutations.py without a registered Go method (silent fallback to Python daemon? hard refusal?); apply receipt forgery surface in the Go service; supervisor packet-injection (untrusted bytes on the FIFO); PID-recycling races in lost-detection; package-data binary substitution attack (wrong-platform binary on disk); CI matrix passing with Go binary missing (build failure masked as skip); daemon_core flip happening implicitly via env-var precedence. Cross-core compatibility: a Python CLI client v1.N talking to a Go daemon v1.N+1 should refuse cleanly via the daemon.hello version handshake.
